svg.aria-label: What's in the box for W5. In the box, three items. First, shaped this cycle: the human-input path — an agent seat owns the task and parks the row with a reason, the parked row's audience derives to a principal, and the person answers through a flow action bound to that principal, after which the flow decides what the answer means and continues; the org chart holds the durable bind of people alongside agent seats, as inventory, members and principals, so a redeploy does not forget who owed a sign-off. People are not board drainers. Then a dashed ship fence band saying that the fence lifted on September 20, when W4's first cut landed, and that neither row below it has started. Below the fence, two items, unfenced but not yet begun: the reference consumer, which is the kitchen-sink rebuild as a runnable app with durable hire, channels, seats, boards and inventory, running its own epic lifecycle; and working assemblies, reference surfaces composing the W3 floor with the W4 first cut, whose child cut is undecided. A note says everything in the box is made of W3 and W4 pieces, and only the top row is new. Composed in by the app: its own channel kinds and CHANNEL.md files, and its own approval and Waiting-on-you rendering. Consumed, not owned: the W3 floor, which has landed, and the W4 first cut, which has also landed. Below a second fence, what is not built: no Human, Team, Channel or Agent as an L1 type; no parallel HITL plane and no human-only side boards; no merged board-assignee and seat registry; no new L1 TaskStatus for Waiting-on-you or Idle; no Collab RC as the whole of W5; no kitchen-sink-only APIs, KS-only durable store or in-memory-only hire; no DevForce or CyberForce Lab product inside the kitchen-sink; no seats plugged into supervisor or patterns factories as L2 primitives; no nested sessions as the work control plane; no second skill registry and no second memory story for human principals; and, removed by the D2 flip on September 20, no person as a board drainer and no flow-colon-human drain kind on the W5 spine.
